Key distinguishing features:
- Interveinal chlorosis (yellow) progressing to necrosis (brown) — hallmark of SDS
- Major veins remain clearly green
- Affects upper canopy leaves
- No purple/bronze discoloration (rules out Cercospora)
- Not small discrete spots (rules out Septoria, Frogeye)
- Not vein-associated necrosis (rules out Soybean Vein Necrosis)
- Brown Stem Rot can look similar foliar-wise, but the pattern here is more characteristic of SDS with distinct chlorotic-to-necrotic blotches
